discovery_notes: WDW 2017 OE backfill; 30 WebSearch calls, all search_snippet, mostly Disney Pins Blog. The 2017-dated line began appearing Dec 2016. Many pins shared DLR/WDW. Disney Films, 28 & Main and Crooked Comrades are limited release, recorded as leads for the LE cell. Main Street Mouse (Feb 2017) said Digital Disney would come in summer; DPB says late March. Tsum holiday count 10 per DPB; a reseller said 8 (not used). Kilimanjaro Safari PODH and Train Conductor Mickey (LE 3000, DLR) skipped as non-OE. Kingdom of Cute location unconfirmed.
